Corrigendum for Tender Notice 2017-18 (ICMR Zoonosis Project)
Thursday, 08 June 2017
5856 Hits
The corrigendum for the Tender Notice (2017-18) - ICMR Zoonosis Project is being published with respect to the following for which the technical specifications are revised.
Article No. 1, 2 & 3 i.e. 1) CO2 Incubator, 2) Real Time PCR Machine & 3) Laminar Hood
Tender forms with revised specifications can be obtained by sending email to ‘
centralstore@mgims.ac.in
’ or can be downloaded from the institute website (www.mgims.ac.in).
The last date of submission of tender and other terms and conditions remain same as in the original Tender Notice (2017-18) - ICMR Zoonosis Project. The Purchase Committee reserves the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason.
Tender Document
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
